name: Vial of Innocent Blood
summary: Syndicate shadow mages gather Vial of Innocent Blood in the ruins of Durnholde Keep. The Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill seeks it as a catalyst for experimental toxins.

sections.title: A Gruesome Reagent
sections.body: Syndicate shadow mages gather innocent blood in the ruins of Durnholde Keep. The Syndicate's fallen human nobles practice dark arts within the crumbled walls. Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill wants untainted blood for an experimental pacifying agent. He means to use it against the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains, and sees the Syndicate's stores as a convenient source.

faq.q: What is the Vial of Innocent Blood used for?
aliases: what is vial of innocent blood for
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill uses the blood to brew a toxin meant to suppress aggression among Venture Company operators troubling the Horde in Stonetalon Mountains.

aliases: who drops vial of innocent blood
faq.answer: Syndicate shadow mages carry the vials around the ruined fortress of Durnholde Keep in the southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why do Syndicate shadow mages have innocent blood?
faq.answer: The Syndicate's human brigands and fallen nobles employ shadow casters to harvest and preserve innocent blood for dark magical experiments.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon need blood from innocents?
faq.answer: Lydon says innocent blood has rare properties needed to make a concoction that bleeds violence from its victims and renders them docile.

angles.text: As an undead, you know the Royal Apothecary Society will use morally questionable ingredients, gathering from human outlaws to advance its alchemy.
As a member of the Horde, securing this reagent helps its efforts against Venture Company deforestation in Stonetalon.
